category_title: Young adults with profound intellectual disability who communicate through non-verbal vocalizations and physical approach or withdrawal
student_description: John is a young adult with profound intellectual disability who communicates via non-verbal vocalizations and physical actions. He exhibits task resistance (dropping his head, looking blank) when given complex verbal commands and defensive restraint when physically blocked. He uniquely requires simplified communication, predictable routines, and interactions where his pre-symbolic signals are respected and he is allowed to take the lead.

criteria.rationale: John requires established, predictable patterns to achieve a state of harmony and successfully engage over time.
criteria.check: The long-term plan incorporates the development and consistent use of predictable, established routines for interactions and daily tasks.

criteria.rationale: Treating John as an equal communication partner fosters mutual understanding and improves his quality of life despite his profound disabilities.
criteria.check: The long-term plan explicitly frames John as an equal partner in communication, focusing on mutual esteem and shared interaction rather than one-way compliance training.
